author: Forbes
description:
On this episode of The Performance Layer, AEG President and COO Nick Baker and Los Angeles Kings Vice President of Strategy, Analytics, and Technology Suzi Alvarez sat down with Forbes to discuss the expanding business operations, rising sponsorship revenue, and technical innovation within the National Hockey League and the Los Angeles Kings. Baker also discussed using artificial intelligence to better understand fan demographics and optimize live stadium experiences. Alvarez further discussed how data analytics help measure evolving brand awareness, insulate the fan experience from on-ice performance fluctuations, and optimize modern digital sponsorship inventory like digital dasherboards.
